window_note: Taken from the ground-truth box at frame 0. Keep the window tight to the subject: a window that includes background makes the hue histogram background-dominated and mean shift will lock onto the shelf.
tracker_note: cv2.TrackerCSRT_create and cv2.TrackerKCF_create are NOT in the base opencv-python wheel - they require opencv-contrib-python. cv2.TrackerMIL_create is built in, which is why it is used here.

backprojection_mask.why: the saturation and value floors exclude washed-out pixels that would otherwise dominate the hue histogram

fixed_defaults_note: backprojection_mask, term_criteria and optical_flow below document fixed source defaults; editing them does not configure this implementation.
